name: orbea-spacelines
description: Lancement groupé de l'API et du site Orbéa Spacelines

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix server && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently --kill-others -n api,site -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
